_note: Development set for prompt work. Never part of the evaluation. Same devices and labelling rules as the frozen set.

items.text: The IV-220 showed the infusion as complete but about 100 mL was still in the bag. The patient's antibiotic dose was short. No clinical effect noticed so far.
Please confirm whether the PX-40 can be cleaned with alcohol wipes.
A resident's arm slipped between the side rail bars and was trapped until staff freed it. She has a large bruise and was seen by the doctor, who ordered an X-ray; no fracture.
The WD-12 boxes we received have labels in Dutch only. The dressings inside look normal.
During use the NB-3 became very hot near the battery and burned my daughter's hand. She has a blister and we went to the GP, who dressed it.
An IV-220 delivered a full syringe of insulin in under a minute when the line was opened. The patient became hypoglycaemic, lost consciousness and needed intravenous glucose. Cause not yet known.
Love the PX-40, it is so easy to use. Do you make one for children?
The HB-7 raises very slowly and makes a grinding noise. We have stopped using it until it is checked.
